title: E1 SRD reference store + lookup_srd tool
description: Reusable, campaign-independent structured D&D 5e SRD data: monsters, spells, AND character-build options (races, classes/subclasses per SRD, backgrounds, feats, starting equipment, spell lists). Reframes the old heavy rules KB into structured lookup, not RAG. Consumed by E2 (srd_ref), E5 (running creatures), E7 (creation choices).
design: Architecture: Add a read-only core SRD module backed by bundled structured TypeScript data, not RAG and not campaign state. The module exposes stable refs plus normalized exact-name lookup for supported kinds; unknown or ambiguous lookups return typed not-found errors instead of fuzzy matches. File map: create packages/core/src/srd/types.ts for public data shapes, packages/core/src/srd/data.ts for the bundled SRD 5.1 seed catalog and license metadata, packages/core/src/srd/store.ts for exact indexes and lookup behavior, packages/core/src/srd/lookup.ts for the lookup_srd tool facade; modify packages/core/src/index.ts to export the public API; add packages/core/test/srd.test.ts for TDD coverage. Tech stack: TypeScript ES modules, Vitest, in-memory readonly catalog for MVP with SQLite migration left to a future scaling issue if full SRD ingestion needs it. Tradeoff: start with a small license-recorded SRD 5.1 seed set proving monster, spell, and class build-option behavior; keep data shapes broad enough for additional SRD records without changing the lookup API.
acceptance_criteria: Completion criteria: known monster, spell, and class build option resolve by exact name and stable ref; lookup_srd rejects fuzzy/partial names and wrong kinds; returned data includes SRD 5.1 CC-BY-4.0 attribution metadata; npm run build and npm run test pass from the worktree.
notes: SYNTHESIS UPDATE 2026-05-17: SRD rules data remains a separate mechanics/reference store, not mixed into campaign lore or generated memory. License and attribution for SRD-derived data are required product behavior, not just documentation.
close_reason: Implemented SRD reference store MVP: typed licensed SRD 5.1 seed catalog, exact lookup_srd facade, public core exports, and attribution metadata; all child tasks closed; verification: npm run build passed and npm run test passed with 25 passed / 1 skipped.
